stories.headline: Mastercard and Wells Fargo Target the Friction Slowing B2B Cards
stories.body: For decades, B2B payments have been treated as back‑office plumbing—necessary, unglamorous and largely unchanged. Invoices pile up, checks linger and reconciliation remains stubbornly manual. stories.headline: Powell plays his last card as Fed chair
stories.body: Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell told reporters Wednesday that he would remain on the Fed board after his term as chair expires next month, resolving the last and most significant open question about his departure and the onset of Kevin Warsh's leadership at the central bank.
